newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers unit buys Thomson unit.
newsitem.headline: Rogers unit buys Thomson unit.

text.p: Rogers Communications Inc unit Maclean Hunter Publishing Ltd said on Friday it has bought the assets of Thomson Healthcare Communications for an undisclosed sum effective January 31.
The core Thomson medical publications Family Practice, Patient Care, L'Omnipracticien, Pharmacy Practice, Hospital Pharmacy Practice, Pharmacy Post will be included as well as Custom Communications.
Maclean Hunter owns The Medical Post, L'actualite medicale and Benefits Canada.

"This transaction should also strengthen the position of Maclean Hunter and the Rogers group of companies in the field of medical and health content, something of interest to increasing numbers of Canadians," Maclean Hunter chief executive John Tory said in a statement.
